subject: infra.capacity
name: Compute or high-performance computing capacity

subject: data.open
name: Open government data portal
what_would_settle_it: A national open-data portal, the published National Data Governance Policy text, or an access-to-information instrument.

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: National AI strategy
what_would_settle_it: A national AI strategy or statute, or a ministerial statement giving its drafting stage and expected adoption date.
